cat > programs/task-80accfa2.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    marks={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 7}
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        cs=[c for rr,c in marks if rr==r]
        if len(cs)>=2:
            for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1):
                if out[r][c]==1: out[r][c]=3
    for c in range(w):
        rs=[r for r,cc in marks if cc==c]
        if len(rs)>=2:
            for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1):
                if out[r][c]==1: out[r][c]=3
    return out
PY
